verdict.rationale: Reranking is a fair question for a hybrid graph, vector and text database, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only vector ranking by distance, BM25 text search, and graph pre-filtering before vector ranking. Nothing in the pack documents built-in reranking models or a first-party reranker integration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models
